mapper.select: SELECT A.DETAIL_CODE_VALUE AS code , B.MESSAGE_CN AS name FROM CM_CODE_DETAIL A INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.LANG_KEY = A.CODE_LANG_KEY AND B.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD WHERE A.CODE_ID = #{codeId} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' AND A.CMPNY_CD = 'CMMN' AND B.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} ORDER BY A.SORTING_SQ ASC

SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.CMPNY_NM AS cmpnyNm , A.ENTRPRS_GB AS entrprsGb , A.BSNS_NO AS bsnsNo , A.CPR_NO AS cprNo , A.CXFC AS cxfc , A.NATION_CD AS nationCd , A.ZIP_CD AS zipCd , A.ADRES_ONE AS adresOne , A.ADRES_TWO AS adresTwo , A.CITY_NM AS cityNm , A.STATE_NM AS stateNm , A.OFFM_TELNO AS offmTelno , A.FXNUM AS fxnum , A.INDUTY_CD AS indutyCd , A.SBSCRB_DT AS sbscrbDt , A.SBSCRB_STTUS AS sbscrbSttus , A.EXPRTN_YMD AS exprtnYmd , A.APPLCNT_ID AS applcntId , A.APPLCNT_NM AS applcntNm , A.APPLCNT_EMAIL AS applcntEmail , A.USE_FL AS useFl , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS creationDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updateDt FROM CM_CMPNY A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(BASE.ID) = 0 THEN 'O' ELSE 'X' END FROM ( SELECT CMPNY_CD AS ID FROM CM_CMPNY WHERE UPPER(CMPNY_CD) = UPPER(#{cmpnyCd}) UNION SELECT USER_ID AS ID FROM CM_USER WHERE UPPER(USER_ID) = UPPER(#{cmpnyCd}) ) BASE

SELECT IFNULL(S.USE_STPLAT_CN, '') AS useStplatCn , IFNULL(S.INFO_PROVD_AGRE_CN, '') AS infoProvdAgreCn FROM CM_STPLAT S WHERE S.USE_STPLAT_ID = ( SELECT CAST(A.DETAIL_CODE_ID AS UNSIGNED) FROM CM_CODE_DETAIL A WHERE A.CODE_ID = 'CMMNCODE.550' AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' AND A.CMPNY_CD = 'CMMN' ORDER BY A.SORTING_SQ ASC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_CMPNY ( CMPNY_CD, CMPNY_NM, ENTRPRS_GB, INDUTY_CD, CXFC, BSNS_NO, CPR_NO, ADRES_ONE, ADRES_TWO, CITY_NM, STATE_NM, NATION_CD, ZIP_CD, OFFM_TELNO, FXNUM, APPLCNT_ID, APPLCNT_NM, APPLCNT_EMAIL, SBSCRB_DT, EXPRTN_YMD, SBSCRB_STTUS, USE_FL, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT ) VALUES ( #{cmpnyCd}, #{cmpnyNm}, #{entrprsGb}, #{indutyCd}, #{cxfc}, #{bsnsNo}, #{cprNo}, #{adresOne}, #{adresTwo}, #{cityNm}, #{stateNm}, #{nationCd}, #{zipCd}, #{offmTelno}, #{fxnum}, #{applcntId}, #{applcntNm}, #{applcntEmail}, NOW(), #{exprtnYmd}, #{sbscrbSttus}, IFNULL(#{useFl}, 'Y'), #{creationId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE CM_CMPNY SET CMPNY_NM = #{cmpnyNm}, ENTRPRS_GB = #{entrprsGb}, INDUTY_CD = #{indutyCd}, CXFC = #{cxfc}, BSNS_NO = #{bsnsNo}, CPR_NO = #{cprNo}, ADRES_ONE = #{adresOne}, ADRES_TWO = #{adresTwo}, CITY_NM = #{cityNm}, STATE_NM = #{stateNm}, NATION_CD = #{nationCd}, ZIP_CD = #{zipCd}, OFFM_TELNO = #{offmTelno}, FXNUM = #{fxnum}, APPLCNT_NM = #{applcntNm}, APPLCNT_EMAIL = #{applcntEmail}, EXPRTN_YMD = CASE WHEN #{sbscrbSttus} = 'D' THEN DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') ELSE #{exprtnYmd} END, SBSCRB_DT = CASE WHEN #{sbscrbSttus} = 'A' THEN NOW() ELSE SBSCRB_DT END, SBSCRB_STTUS = #{sbscrbSttus}, USE_FL = CASE WHEN #{sbscrbSttus} = 'D' THEN 'N' ELSE IFNULL(#{useFl}, USE_FL) END, UPDATE_ID = #{updateId}, UPDATE_DT = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}
UPDATE CM_CMPNY SET SBSCRB_STTUS = 'D', USE_FL = 'N', EXPRTN_YMD = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), UPDATE_ID = #{updateId}, UPDATE_DT = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}
